clock.ordering: expire shocks -> settle contract events -> apply project progress -> apply policy lifecycle -> market clearing -> macro/stability update -> snapshot

scenarios.name: Transfers offset a VAT shock

expected_direction.poverty: falls more than transfer alone because INT-001

invariants: each action has unique idempotency key
no effect before its lag

scenarios.name: Inflation, debt, FX and capital flight feedback
invariants: swap cannot add reserves above drawn amount
control expires by day 120
no positive external financing created without counterparty ledger

scenarios.name: Trade interruption, stock depletion and shortage

expected_direction.delivered_imports: fall or reroute with longer cost
expected_direction.shortage: positive only when available stock plus flow below demand

invariants: unmet imports are recorded, not manufactured
reserve release cannot exceed verified stock

scenarios.name: Late invoice, partial fulfilment and restructuring

expected_direction.loss: uses collateral and insured recovery before creditor loss

invariants: contract status transitions only along rules
no double close-out

scenarios.name: Project delay, leakage and lagged completion effect

expected_direction.productivity: zero before completion; positive only as ramp proceeds

invariants: delay roll is stored in snapshot
effect is not applied at award

scenarios.name: Bank run and collateralized liquidity support
invariants: support limited by eligible collateral
insolvent bank enters resolution not endless liquidity

scenarios.name: Protest, institutional collapse and staged recovery

expected_direction.permissions: contract after collapse per governance gates
expected_direction.recovery: restores permissions gradually, never rewinds arrears

invariants: collapse is a state transition, not deletion of history
no observed fact is asserted by threshold

scenarios.name: Empty territory does not issue new policy

expected_direction.contract: settles if counterparties and route exist
expected_direction.project: continues, delays or is destroyed by events

invariants: no new actor action from empty territory
old effect not reset

scenarios.name: Duplicate task delivery is idempotent
invariants: economic state same as single-event replay

scenarios.name: Historical snapshot and deterministic replay

expected_direction.snapshot_hash: identical for original and replay using same version/seed/event ordering

invariants: source versions embedded in snapshot
event log is append-only

validation: all numeric events have units or documented interpretation
